description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller that provides basic endpoints for welcoming users, health checks, API documentation redirects, and application info. It also utilizes Swagger annotations for API documentation purposes.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller providing endpoints for greeting, health status, Swagger UI redirection, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' and redirects to the Swagger UI, preserving the request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns a simple health status string.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/info' and returns basic application information.
